title: Zesty Dutch Vegetable Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful vegetarian stew made with the bold flavors of Dutch cuisine. This gluten-free stew is perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat the Dutch broth in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced almond and cook for 2-3 minutes until lightly toasted.
Add the onion, garlic, potatoes, carrots, and zucchini to the pot.
Stir in the zesty seasoning and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Optional: garnish with additional sliced almonds and a sprinkle of zesty seasoning.
